tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Submission of Annexure-2 of the prescribed tender form filled with complete information
Submission of the declaration as per Annexure-3 of the tender notice with the signature of the tenderer
List of air-conditioned (AC) vehicles and names to be provided.
Document stating that the vehicle to be provided is compulsorily registered with yellow board (separate document to be submitted for each vehicle).
Valid Fitness Certificate Copy of the vehicle to be provided. (Valid Fitness Certificate Copy) (Separate document to be submitted for each vehicle.)
Valid insurance certificate of the vehicle to be provided. (Submit a separate document for each vehicle.)
Tax Paid Copy of the vehicle being serviced. (Submit a separate document for each vehicle.)
Submit a separate copy of the driver's driving licence for each vehicle.
Tenderers providing services to vehicles of different ownership should attach a copy of the agreement signed with the original owner.
Income Tax Return Copy filed for the financial year 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24.
Audit Report from a Chartered Accountant for the financial year 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24.
